ZAF.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
The Electronic Travel Authorisation using machine learning and AI is only a stated wish to introduce, not a pilot or tender.
No AI tool in a sector system is stated.
No locally built AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
The digital wallet is described as a possibility; no authentication service is authorised, contracted or piloted.
No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
No digital civil registration is stated.
No count or share of people holding the ID is given.
No ID number at birth is stated.
Nothing stated on who operates or maintains the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated; grant fraud is only a possibility.

facts.fact: Minister Leon Schreiber told Parliament in February 2025 that Home Affairs is building the first components of a biometrically secured digital ID.
Minister Schreiber said the Trusted Tour Operator Scheme visa portal was built in-house by Home Affairs' own software development team.

ZAF.note: Nothing stated on local civil registration offices entering events digitally.
